title: Office
description: Canonical structural contract for a purebliss office module (charter.yaml, abilities.yaml, reports.yaml and, where an office declares one, delivery-lifecycle.yaml) under registry/personas/offices/<office>/. Originated as the CTO-only schema (issue #1573, Parent #1510) at registry/personas/offices/cto/schema/office.schema.json; generalized here to the shared canonical location (registry/personas/offices/schema/office.schema.json) when the CEO/CFO/PMO office directories were added (lane-purebliss-org) so every office validates against ONE schema instead of a per-office copy. Validated by registry/personas/tests/test_cto_office.py and test_office_modules.py, wired into the existing pytest-registry-personas suite (scripts/verify.sh). This schema validates STRUCTURE only; cross-references (member ids resolving to real cards, verb ids existing in control-plane/control/verbs.yaml) are checked by the test modules, not by this schema alone. NOTE (delta, not yet reconciled): registry/personas/offices/cfo/charter.yaml predates this canonicalization and uses a different, incompatible field shape (schemaVersion/tenant/personaCardRef/authority.{grants,denies} instead of schema+version/scopeOfAuthority/mayApprove/mayNotApprove) validated separately by registry/personas/offices/schema/office-charter-legacy-cfo.schema.json (moved next to this file, unmerged); reshaping it onto this schema is a follow-up, not done in this change.

provenance.description: GR-10 provenance: required on every office file that declares harvested content (charter, abilities).

toolAllowlistExtends.description: Pointer of the form '<card path>#toolAllowlist' this office's abilities.yaml extends rather than redefines.
